- If you need additional evidence from our side (we attached our VAT certificate and the original invoice)?

We'd like to avoid a credit hold impacting the integration delivery — if we can get a corrected invoice by EOD Friday we can release payment next week.

Jonas, Ben — I ran a quick check via VIES and CloudNova's IE VAT (IE987654321) returns as active and a B2B registration. That supports reverse-charge treatment. Notes below:

- For EU B2B (customer in Ireland), we can issue a net invoice referencing the reverse-charge article and include the customer's VAT ID on the invoice. That removes the VAT liability from Redwood.
- We need to reissue a credit note for the gross invoice (4892) and issue a replacement net invoice.
- Wording: include phrase "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient" and reference our VAT number and the customer's VAT number. Legal has previously accepted this wording for EU customers.
- Accounting impact: revenue recognition remains unchanged (we'll process the credit & replacement in the same period), but bookkeeping needs the credit note id to tie to 4892.

Operational ask: Can Billing Ops create a ticket to issue the credit and new invoice and mark the original as superseded? If so, I approve proceeding today and will loop Legal if any edge case appears.
